samples.xml_description:
<module id="alu">
    <description>ALU for MIPS ISA CPU. Operates on 32-bit operands a and b. aluc is the opcode, and r is the output result.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">32-bit input operand a.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">32-bit input operand b.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit control signal for selecting the operation to be performed.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">32-bit output representing the result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">A 1-bit output indicating whether the result is zero.</output>
        <output id="carry">A 1-bit output indicating whether a carry occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="negative">A 1-bit output indicating whether the result is negative.</output>
        <output id="overflow">A 1-bit output indicating whether an overflow occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="flag">A 1-bit output representing a general flag, which is set based on specific operations (SLT and SLTU).</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ADD">6'b100000</parameter>
        <parameter id="ADDU">6'b100001</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUB">6'b100010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUBU">6'b100011</parameter>
        <parameter id="AND">6'b100100</parameter>
        <parameter id="OR">6'b100101</parameter>
        <parameter id="XOR">6'b100110</parameter>
        <parameter id="NOR">6'b100111</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLT">6'b101010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLTU">6'b101011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLL">6'b000000</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRL">6'b000010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRA">6'b000011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLLV">6'b000100</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRLV">6'b000110</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRAV">6'b000111</parameter>
        <parameter id="LUI">6'b001111</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="res" width_description="[31:0]"/>
        <wire id="signed_a" width_description="[31:0]"/> // Signed wire for operand a
        <wire id="signed_b" width_description="[31:0]"/> // Signed wire for operand b
        <assign id="signed_a" src="a"/>
        <assign id="signed_b" src="b"/>
        <assign id="r" src="res[31:0]"/>
        <assign id="flag" src="(aluc == SLT || aluc == SLTU) ? res : 1'bz"/>
        <assign id="zero" src="~|res ? 1'b1 : 1'b0"/>
        <assign id="carry" src="~(aluc == SUB | aluc == SUBU) & ~(|res) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0"/>
        <assign id="negative" src="~((aluc == SUB | aluc == SUBU) & (~&res)) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0"/>
        <assign id="overflow" src="~((aluc == ADD | aluc == ADDU) & (res != signed_a + signed_b)) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0"/>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        reg [31:0] res;
        wire [31:0] signed_a, signed_b;
        
        assign signed_a = a;
        assign signed_b = b;
        assign r = res[31:0];
        assign flag = (aluc == SLT || aluc == SLTU) ? res : 1'bz;
        assign zero = ~|res ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
        assign carry = ~(aluc == SUB | aluc == SUBU) & ~(|res) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
        assign negative = ~((aluc == SUB | aluc == SUBU) & (~&res)) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
        assign overflow = ~((aluc == ADD | aluc == ADDU) & (res != signed_a + signed_b)) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
    
        always @(a or b or aluc) begin
            case(aluc)
                ADD: res <= signed_a + signed_b;
                ADDU: res <= a + b;
                SUB: res <= signed_a - signed_b;
                SUBU: res <= a - b;
                AND: res <= a & b;
                OR: res <= a | b;
                XOR: res <= a ^ b;
                NOR: res <= ~(a | b);
                SLT: res <= signed_a < signed_b ? 1 : 0;
                SLTU: res <= a < b ? 1 : 0;
                SLL: res <= b << a[4:0]; // Shift left logical by a[4:0]
                SRL: res <= b >> a[4:0]; // Shift right logical by a[4:0]
                SRA: res <= b >>> a[4:0]; // Shift right arithmetic by a[4:0]
                SLLV: res <= b << a[4:0]; // Shift left logical by a[4:0]
                SRLV: res <= b >> a[4:0]; // Shift right logical by a[4:0]
                SRAV: res <= b >>> a[4:0]; // Shift right arithmetic by a[4:0]
                LUI: res <= {a[15:0], 16'd0};
                default: res <= 32'dz; // Default case to handle undefined values
            endcase
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
